entries.zh: 剥皮；剥去兽皮
entries.en: to skin, to flay; to strip off a hide

entries.zh: 强剥；用力剥下（兽皮）
entries.en: to skin by force; to tear off forcibly
entries.notes: H 第二字作「未/末」，于义无取，疑为「皮」之讹；M/R 第二音节 lā 亦未详，义依西语 por fuerza 定。

entries.zh: 蝉蜕；蝉脱下的壳（中药材），字面义「剥蝉皮」
entries.en: cicada slough (used as medicine); lit. to skin a cicada

entries.zh: 扒皮；剥去果皮
entries.en: to peel (fruit); to strip off the skin
entries.notes: H 栏[疑:扒/朳]；M「pe」合「扒」白读，义从西语 fruta。

entries.zh: 轻佻浮躁；做事无序、不按规矩
entries.en: frivolous, skittish; disorderly in doing
entries.notes: H 作「跳」，与 desorden 之对应或通「佻」（轻佻），未可定夺。

entries.zh: 非法；不合法度、违背规矩
entries.en: unlawful, illegitimate; improper, contrary to rule

entries.zh: 粗野；放野不羁、无规矩
entries.en: wild, uncouth; unruly
entries.notes: M 调号 T99 污损，H「野」与 R「yè」互证，义读不受影响。

entries.zh: 非正路；不走正道、方法不正当
entries.en: not the proper way; irregular, improper
entries.notes: M/R「正」字调号 T99 污损，字面与西语 desordenado 相合。

entries.zh: 非为；不正当的作为、胡作非为
entries.en: wrongdoing, misconduct; to act improperly

entries.zh: 世情；世俗人情、世态（西语释为「风俗失序」）
entries.en: the ways of the world, worldly customs; disorderly in morals
entries.notes: M、R 两栏同形（ʃy chēng），R 栏疑袭 M；首音节调号 T99。

entries.zh: 紊乱；杂乱无章
entries.en: disordered, confused; tangled

entries.zh: 滥三；做事马虎潦草、生活放荡不检
entries.en: slipshod, slovenly; disorderly and dissolute (of life)

entries.zh: 发落；处置、了结（案件）
entries.en: to dispose of, settle (a case); to dispatch

entries.zh: 打发；派遣、遣走，亦指处理、应付
entries.en: to send off, dispatch; to dismiss; to dispose of

entries.zh: 文书、公文（西语谓替国王或官员办理、投递文书）
entries.en: official documents; to dispatch papers for the King or a Mandarin
entries.notes: M 首音节 gî 与 H 栏两字不合，疑原有「拟/议」字；R 亦仅两音节。

entries.zh: 批允；批准所请（于呈状批答照准）
entries.en: to approve a petition; to grant a request by endorsement
entries.notes: H 栏[疑:批/挞]；M「pēy」合「批」音，[疑]可释。

entries.zh: 开拆；拆开封缄（信件、公文）
entries.en: to open (a sealed letter); to break a seal
entries.notes: M 第二音节 fâ 与「拆」常读不合，唯 H 栏与西语 despachar 相合。

entries.zh: 折断；使断裂（西语谓从速了结、截断）
entries.en: to break off, snap; to cut short
entries.notes: M「chiēt」收 -t 尾，合「折」之文读，H 栏「拆」或为形近误录。

entries.zh: 决断；果断裁断、决定
entries.en: to decide, resolve; to settle promptly

entries.zh: 起本；具本上奏（官员向君上呈递奏本）
entries.en: to send up a memorial to the throne; to dispatch a mandarin's memorial for the King
